title: Robustness Testing Framework for Steering Vectors

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Robustness certification is essential before production deployment. A framework that identifies when steering breaks down directly prevents unsafe deployments. Clear chain from testing to safety assurance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Each perturbation type (paraphrase, temperature, LoRA, language) is individually manageable. Combining them into a test suite requires software engineering. The LoRA fine-tuning perturbation adds compute requirements.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Four perturbation types each requiring separate implementation and evaluation. A full testing framework with per-perturbation scoring is substantial. Could be narrowed to 2 perturbation types but as stated is too broad for 30 hours.
